log.action.allowBatteryCooling: Allow the device battery to return to a safe temperature
log.action.checkNetwork: Check network access and Eufy service availability
log.action.checkPhysicalArmingMode: Check the physical security-system mode before retrying
log.action.checkPhysicalLight: Check the physical smart-light state before retrying
log.action.checkPhysicalLock: Check the physical lock state before retrying
log.action.checkCameraSnapshot: Check that the camera is reachable and can produce an image, then open the camera again
log.action.waitCameraControl: No action is needed; the control returns when the camera reports it again
log.action.checkCameraControl: Check the camera in the Eufy app; this control is unavailable until it reports its state
log.action.retryCameraControl: Try the control again; the camera did not confirm the change
log.action.enableCamera: Turn the camera on in the Eufy app, then open live view again
log.action.openDashboard: Review device representation in the Homebridge Eufy dashboard
log.action.reduceConcurrentMedia: Open live view again; if it keeps happening, close a camera already open or raise the concurrent camera media limit in the plugin settings
log.action.reauthenticate: Authenticate again in the Homebridge Eufy dashboard, then restart Homebridge
log.action.retryLiveView: Open live view again, and check network access between Homebridge and the camera
log.action.retryTalkback: Close and reopen the camera, then try speaking again
log.action.reviewRuntime: Review Homebridge Eufy health in the dashboard and restart Homebridge
log.action.stopOtherOwner: Stop the other Homebridge Eufy owner before restarting Homebridge
log.action.selectSupportedArmingMode: Select Stay, Away, or Disarm to leave the unsupported mode
log.action.waitBattery: Wait for complete battery capability evidence
log.action.waitArming: Wait for complete arming capability evidence
log.action.waitBatteryObservation: Wait for a valid battery observation
log.action.waitCameraLive: Wait for complete camera live media capability evidence
log.action.waitCameraSnapshot: Wait for complete camera snapshot capability evidence
log.action.waitContact: Wait for complete contact capability evidence
log.action.waitContactObservation: Wait for a valid contact observation
log.action.waitLight: Wait for complete smart-light capability evidence
log.action.waitLightObservation: Wait for a valid smart-light observation
log.action.waitLock: Wait for complete lock capability evidence
log.action.waitSiren: Wait for complete siren capability evidence
log.action.waitSirenObservation: Wait for a valid siren observation
log.action.waitTalkback: Wait for complete camera talkback capability evidence
log.diagnosticFileFailed: Diagnostic file logging failed; check storage permissions.
log.discardedSettings: Some legacy settings were discarded. Review and acknowledge them in the Homebridge Eufy dashboard.
log.snapshotCacheInvalid: An invalid retained camera image was removed
log.homekit.armingReconciliationExpired: A security system did not confirm the requested mode
log.homekit.batteryTemperatureAlert: A device reported a battery temperature alert
log.homekit.cameraLiveSessionFailed: A live camera session ended without video
log.homekit.cameraSnapshotUnavailable: A camera image is unavailable, so a placeholder is shown
log.homekit.cameraControlOperationFailed: A camera control did not take effect
log.homekit.invalidCameraControlObservat: A camera control state could not be read
log.homekit.cameraRecordingRefused: Recording is unavailable because the camera is turned off
log.homekit.cameraLiveSessionRefused: Live view is unavailable because the camera is turned off
log.homekit.cameraMediaAtCapacity: Live view was refused because this host had reached its configured limit of cameras streaming at once
log.homekit.invalidContactObservation: A contact sensor observation is invalid
log.homekit.lightReconciliationExpired: A smart-light did not confirm the requested state
log.homekit.lockReconciliationExpired: A lock did not confirm the requested target
log.homekit.recognizedNotRepresented: Some recognized devices cannot be represented in HomeKit
log.homekit.unsupportedArmingMode: A security system reported a mode Apple Home cannot represent
log.homekit.unusableLockAnnouncement: A lock reported something this plugin cannot read, so its state is shown as unknown
log.notice.eventSubscriberFailed: A device event consumer failed; review Homebridge Eufy health in the dashboard.
log.notice.ownershipAcquisitionFailed: Account ownership could not be acquired; restart Homebridge before retrying.
log.notice.ownershipReleaseFailed: Account ownership release failed; restart Homebridge before retrying.
log.notice.ownershipReleaseIncomplete: Account ownership release remains incomplete; restart Homebridge before retrying.
log.notice.ownershipReleaseNotFinalized: Account ownership release did not finish; restart Homebridge before retrying.
log.notice.registrySubscriberFailed: A device registry consumer failed; review Homebridge Eufy health in the dashboard.
log.notice.shutdownFailed: The Eufy runtime did not shut down cleanly; restart Homebridge before retrying.
log.notice.shutdownTimeout: The Eufy runtime exceeded its shutdown deadline; Homebridge shutdown will continue.
log.notice.shutdownTimeoutWithDuration: The Eufy runtime exceeded its shutdown deadline; Homebridge shutdown will continue. ({durationMs} ms)
log.notice.stateSubscriberFailed: A runtime state consumer failed; review Homebridge Eufy health in the dashboard.
log.notice.statusPublicationFailed: Runtime status could not be published; dashboard status may be stale.
log.runtime.ownerConflict: Another process owns the Eufy account session
log.action.checkCameraRecording: Check that HomeKit Secure Video is set up for this camera and that it reports motion
log.action.retryRecording: No action is needed; recording is attempted again on the next trigger
log.homekit.cameraRecordingUnavailable: HomeKit Secure Video recording is unavailable for this camera
log.homekit.cameraRecordingFailed: A HomeKit Secure Video recording did not complete
